purpose: Four Spring Boot project workflow topics as eight Korean/English manuscripts, using one staged runnable project.

newEnglishEditions.policy: After explicit approval refresh the four first English publishedAt/updatedAt timestamps before final CI. Keep Korean original dates and all reviewed bodies.

selectionEvidence.source: Search Console API, actual-search-status-2026-10-27.json stored outside the repository
selectionEvidence.importArticle: No observed page row; included to complete the create/import/compile workflow.
selectionEvidence.limits: Small sample on old addresses, not proof of new English search demand.

initializrVerification.limits: Service availability is time-sensitive. Checker does not call Initializr or claim future availability.

review.type: Self AI review in two passes: technical/semantic comparison, then standalone reading in each language.
review.scope: Eight manuscripts and paired project files; official generation metadata, Gradle/IDE/processor documentation, release dates, provenance and public HTML.

findings.issue: Old Initializr screenshots and Boot3.1 setup did not match the current service.
findings.resolution: Generate the documented Boot4.1.2 project for real, record service availability and Wrapper, separate generated core files from complete Wrapper files.

findings.issue: Old IDE tutorial implied manual Application configuration was always required.
findings.resolution: Document main-method gutter execution first and compare Wrapper results with run configuration settings.

findings.issue: Old Lombok tutorial made manual plugin installation and processor checkbox changes universal.
findings.resolution: Distinguish IDE support from main/test Gradle processors; cite automatic import behavior and version-dependent plugin support.

findings.issue: BOM management could be mistaken for starter dependency inclusion or the Boot plugin alone.
findings.resolution: Explain dependency-management plugin/native BOM options and inspect runtime/processor configurations separately.

findings.issue: Polling a child log through the same shared file handle could disturb write offsets.
findings.resolution: Read startup logs through a separate descriptor; final CI runs this exact checker.

limits: CLI and packaged HTTP tested; IDE UI not executed
Initializr metadata and actual generation checked separately
Versions pin this reproduction rather than promise future defaults

siteValidation.eightPageAudit: Passed H1/descriptions/OG/schema dates, self/canonical and reciprocal en/ko/x-default, RSS/search/sitemap, code and no editorial banners.

ci: New staged project checker configured after existing JDK17 examples; exact PR check result tracked separately.
publication: Draft review only; no new batch content deployed before explicit approval.

publicationApproval.basis: User requested continuing after the concrete PR58 draft and successful validation report.
publicationApproval.scope: Publish the four reviewed Korean/English pairs; only first-English publication/modified timestamps changed. Korean original dates and all bodies preserved.
